summary.en: Iranian-linked drones have struck the Khor Mor gas field in Iraqi Kurdistan, halting production and cutting about 2.8 GW of power, while Iraqi officials have asked Iran to close most border crossings and the foreign minister is negotiating militia weapons regulation with Tehran. Airstrikes by Iraqi forces have targeted three suspected militants and a tunnel in Kirkuk's Zghaitun Valley. The Iraqi National Alliance welcomed President Barzani's dialogue initiative and condemned the Khor Mor attack, while the US envoy condemned the attack and backed investigations by Erbil and Baghdad. 396 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
